timeline.evidenceText: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;
but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.”
Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.”
“Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;
